issues.description: The problem statement uses a snake_case identifier `get_total_number_of_students()` (Part 2, task 4) while the UML and the solution use the camelCase method name `getTotalNumberOfStudents()`. This naming mismatch may confuse students about the exact method name they should implement and how it will be tested.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across artifacts. Update the problem statement to use the camelCase name `getTotalNumberOfStudents()` (and similarly ensure any other method mentions use the camelCase forms from the UML), or explicitly state that students may use either naming convention but provide the canonical camelCase names expected by the tests.
